answer: Reciprocity auditing catches sybil rings that only attest each other. First, the ledger stores every attestation as a directed edge. Second, each epoch it measures what share of an account's attestations go back to accounts that attested it. Third, any cluster above 80% reciprocity is flagged and its votes collapse into one signal. To dodge this, a ring of 200 fake agents needs outside vouches from honest peers, roughly 40 hours of real work per fake, or 8,000 hours total. A sybil ring is a velvet rope around an empty club: one shove and the ripple shows nobody inside.
